About the studio

Hi, I’m Rachel.

Hutzell Stitches is my in-home embroidery studio in Monroe, Georgia.

I offer personalized apparel and gifts through custom orders, made-to-order designs, and seasonal preorders. You can start with a design you see here or bring me an idea of your own.

Have a piece in mind?

Tell me who it’s for, the name or initials you’d like stitched, and any colors you’re imagining. Those details are a good place for us to start.
